title: Execution Sigil War: Hidden Law
description: Execution Sigil War unfolds across execution sigil district with blood-dark stones and throne-shadow sightlines, pushing a 5-Titan Infernal Dominion squad to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Execution Sigil War: Hidden Law advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
